en: The Apadāna of the Elder Bhājanapālaka Udakāsanavagga 2 I am the keeper of the vessels for the Saṅgha; I have offered them with a devoted heart. By this root of merit, may I attain The state of an Arhat, free from defilements. Through this deed, I have attained The fruit of Arhatship, free from outflows. Having reached the end of suffering, I dwell in peace, having done what was to be done. I am the keeper of the vessels for the Saṅgha; I have offered them with a devoted heart. For the sake of the Saṅgha of bhikkhus,
I do not recall ever being born in an unhappy state;
this is the fruit of that vessel.
he was a wheel-turning monarch of great power, endowed with the seven treasures.
[and so on] ...the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed the venerable elder Bhājanapālaka spoke these verses.
This is the second legend (apadāna) of the elder Bhājanapālaka.
